reason: The hypothesis combines two distinct strengthening strategies—engineered lattice misfit from high-entropy superalloy studies (P2, P5) and serrated grain boundary morphology from a precipitation-strengthened HEA (P15, P19, P20)—into a single multilayer coating architecture, which none of the passages proposes. The mechanism linking misfit strain fields and non-planar interfaces to dislocation pinning across layers is not stated in any passage, and the transfer to an alternating-layer coating is a new material design.
